title: 5G NR Multicell Twin — SionnaRT-Veg, MEASURED crowns (CBH B), 3.6 GHz
variant: P.833 measured crowns, CBH B = 0.35 x tree height (LiDAR crown top)

grid.cell_order: row-major, index = ri*25+ci; ri = index into ys (ys[0]=-480, increasing north in ENU), ci = index into xs (xs[0]=-480, increasing east in ENU). Identical order to SIONNA.rsrp / SIONNA_VEG.rsrp in 6g-ran-multicell-handoff-v7.html — drop-in replacement for SIONNA_VEG.
grid.coordinates: ENU metres relative to tile centre 37.801105, -122.404175 (downtown San Francisco, 1 km x 1 km tile). Receiver points are the nudged street-level points (ground + 1.5 m); the page looks a cell up by nearest grid point.

sector_order: [625][9] columns are A1,A2,A3,B1,B2,B3,C1,C2,C3 — tower-major, sectors 90/210/330 deg within each tower, matching the page's rsrps() order (tower A,B,C x sector 0,1,2).

provenance.method: ITU-R P.833-10 Eq.(1) foliage loss applied post-trace to the Sionna 3.6 GHz ray-traced grid. Loss per tower-receiver pair, applied equally to all 3 sectors of that tower. phi = 1 for LOS pairs, 0 for non-LOS (lower bound).
provenance.crowns: Measured: NAIP 2022 4-band 0.6 m imagery, NDVI gate 0.15 seeded at the 1,919 DataSF surveyed tree points; LiDAR crown top from OSM-masked 3DEP CHM sampled inside the NDVI footprints; crown base CBH B = 0.35 x LiDAR tree height. 1,503/1,919 trees measured (78.3%), 416 fell back to the DBH rule. Median crown radius 2.99 m, median crown top 11.5 m. SAM 3 was NOT run (no samgeo/GPU on the VM); footprints are NDVI segmentation, not SAM polygons.
source_files: twin5GNR-multicell-SionnaRT-Veg.html (Claude-fixed v7, live) — SIONNA no-veg grid
provenance.build: rsrp_veg in the npz is exactly source rsrp_tilt4 + veg_adj broadcast over the 3 sectors of each tower (verified to <1e-4 dB); this file rounds that grid to 1 decimal place, the same format as the page's embedded SIONNA/SIONNA_VEG grids. NaN = no ray to any sector of that tower (unchanged by trees).
provenance.excluded: The native solid-crown geometry run (tower A only, results_native_measured_B_f3600.npz) is NOT in this file — Claude asked for the per-cell, per-sector grid, which is the P.833 3-tower run.
provenance.replaces_in_page: SIONNA_VEG (old surveyed-disc P.833: mean -0.18 dB, 4.0% cells >1 dB, worst -11.7 dB). This measured grid: mean -0.34 dB, 6.1% cells >1 dB, worst -18.4 dB; coverage and median unchanged (80.5%, -72.7 dBm).
provenance.handoff_note: Handoff on the page-rounded grid is 10.7%; on the unrounded source it is 11.2%. The 0.5 pp is 1-dp rounding flipping cells near the 3 dB boundary, not a real change. Old surveyed veg on the same page-rounded basis was 10.7%.

notes_for_claude: Load rsrp_dbm as the new SIONNA_VEG (same xs/ys, same [625][9] layout after reshaping to [625][3][3] tower-major). Update the comparison note: trees mean -0.34 dB (was -0.18), 6.1% cells >1 dB (was 4.0%), worst -18.4 dB (was -11.7); coverage 80.5% and median -72.7 dBm unchanged. Keep the P.833 lower-bound wording and the (gamma,Am) interpolated caveat.
